info.title: Boing Network public JSON-RPC
info.description:
OpenAPI 3.1 for Boing Network **public testnet** JSON-RPC.

- **Server:** `https://testnet-rpc.boing.network/` (Cloudflare gateway → Fly `boing-testnet-1`).
- **Transport:** JSON-RPC 2.0 over **POST /** (single object or batch array).
- **Methods:** 75 `boing_*` names from `BOING_RPC_SUPPORTED_METHODS` in `crates/boing-node/src/rpc.rs` (unit-tested against `docs/RPC-API-SPEC.md`).
- **No mainnet** endpoint is published or documented here.
- HTTP probes and discovery (`/live`, `/ready`, `/openapi.json`, `/.well-known/boing-rpc`, `/ws`) share the same listener.
- Paths under `/rpc/{method}` are **documentation operations** for GitBook/Scalar; clients must still POST to `/` with a JSON-RPC body.
- Param/result schemas prefer `boing_getRpcMethodCatalog` (51 catalogued); remaining methods link to the prose spec.

tags.name: HTTP
tags.description: Plain HTTP discovery and probes on the same listener as JSON-RPC.

get.description: Returns **405** with **`Allow: GET, HEAD, POST, OPTIONS`** and a short plain-text hint (for `curl` without `-X POST` and browser visits).

405.description: Use **POST /** with JSON-RPC body. Response is plain text; header **Allow** lists methods.

options.description: Handler returns **204** with **`Allow: GET, HEAD, POST, OPTIONS`**. The **CORS** middleware may answer **OPTIONS** first with **200** (preflight); both include allowed methods.

200.description: CORS preflight response (may be empty body).

204.description: Direct **OPTIONS** when CORS passes through; **Allow** lists methods.

post.description: Body is either one **JsonRpcRequest** or a **JSON array** of objects (batch). `method` must be one of the `boing_*` names in `BOING_RPC_SUPPORTED_METHODS` (75 methods). Canonical public **testnet** endpoint: `https://testnet-rpc.boing.network/`. **No public mainnet RPC.** See tagged operations under `/rpc/{method}` for per-method params (documentation paths — actual wire calls always use **POST /**).

parameters.description: Optional correlation id; echoed on the response when present, otherwise a UUID is assigned.
parameters.name: X-Request-Id

200.description: Single JSON-RPC response **or** JSON array of responses (batch). Inspect `error` when present.

204.description: No JSON body: single notification, or batch where **every** request is a notification (JSON-RPC 2.0).

413.description: JSON body larger than **BOING_RPC_MAX_BODY_MB** (default 8 MiB). Response is **application/json** with **`code: payload_too_large`**, **`message`**, and **`request_id`** when known.

429.description: HTTP 429 when global JSON-RPC rate limit applies. Body includes JSON-RPC error **-32016** and optional **`boing_http`** object (**`code: rate_limited`**, **`message`**, **`request_id`**). Header **Retry-After: 1** (seconds) hints backoff. Responses include **x-request-id** (echoed from request or generated).

post.summary: JSON-RPC 2.0 (single object or batch array)

200.description: JSON object with **schema_version** and path hints

get.summary: Machine-readable RPC discovery (paths to OpenAPI, probes, JSON-RPC)

get.description: Default **text/plain** `ok\n`. With **`Accept: application/json`** or **`GET /live.json`**, returns **`{ "ok": true }`**.

Acquires state read lock. If **BOING_RPC_READY_MIN_PEERS** is set (>0), also requires at least that many P2P peers. JSON mode: **Accept: application/json** or **GET /ready.json**; **503** includes **Retry-After: 5** (seconds).

503.description: Peer count below **BOING_RPC_READY_MIN_PEERS** (when configured); JSON body explains **reason**

get.description: After upgrade: send one text frame `{"type":"subscribe","channel":"newHeads"}`; server replies `subscribed` then streams `newHead` JSON objects on each committed block. Optional cap: **BOING_RPC_WS_MAX_CONNECTIONS** (0 = unlimited); when exceeded, handshake returns **503**.

post.summary: Name, symbol, decimals and total supply for ANY token contract, not only tokens in a DEX pool. Params: ["0x<32-byte i...
post.description:
JSON-RPC method **`boing_getTokenMetadata`**.
Call via **POST /** on the testnet RPC (this path is documentation-only for OpenAPI tooling).

**Summary:** Name, symbol, decimals and total supply for ANY token contract, not only tokens in a DEX pool. Params: ["0x<32-byte id>"] or [{ "id": "0x…" }]. name/symbol exist only in the deploy transaction (ContractDeployWithPurposeAndMetadata); null when the token was deployed without them (never an abbreviation). decimals: BOING_DEX_TOKEN_DECIMALS_JSON, else 0 for reference fungible template code, 18 for wrapped BOING, else null. totalSupply is a decimal string: wrapped BOING from storage, reference tokens from the one-time mint_first call (totalSupplySource), else null. Returns null when the id has no contract code and no recorded deploy. Non-consensus; works without a DEX factory.

DexDiscoveryParams.description: Params object for boing_listDexPools / boing_listDexTokens / boing_getDexToken (single-element JSON-RPC params array).

enrich.description: When false, same as light: true.

id.description: getDexToken only: 32-byte token account id hex.

includeDiagnostics.description: When true, include diagnostics counters on the result.

light.description: When true, skip receipt + deploy scans (heights null; token metadataSource abbrev-only).

minLiquidityWei.description: listDexTokens only: decimal digit string u128 per-leg minimum.

minReserveProduct.description: listDexTokens only: decimal digit string u128 filter.

id.description: Request id. Omit for a notification (no response entry).

method.description: JSON-RPC method name. Full set matches BOING_RPC_SUPPORTED_METHODS / boing_rpcSupportedMethods.

x-enumDescriptions.boing_chainHeight: Return the height of the latest committed block on this node (see [Chain tip, committed height, and finality](#chain-tip-committed-height-and-finality)).
x-enumDescriptions.boing_checkNames: Availability and yearly rent for 1-25 names: params [[name, ...]].
x-enumDescriptions.boing_clientVersion: Result: string — e.g. `boing-node/0.1.0` (crate version). Lets clients and `npm run probe-rpc` confirm they are talking to a freshly built binary.
x-enumDescriptions.boing_getAccount: Get full account state (balance, nonce, stake). Recommended for wallets to build transactions (nonce) and show balance/stake.
x-enumDescriptions.boing_getAccountProof: Get a Merkle proof for an account.
x-enumDescriptions.boing_getAccountTransactions: Committed transactions that touch an account, newest first. A transaction touches an account when the account is the sender, a native transfer recipient, a batch step recipient / called contract, t...
x-enumDescriptions.boing_getBalance: Get the spendable balance for an account. Recommended for wallets (e.g. boing.express) to display balance without deriving from state.
x-enumDescriptions.boing_getBlob: Bytes (dataHex) plus metadata for a media blob, or null.
x-enumDescriptions.boing_getBlobMeta: Metadata for a content-addressed media blob id, or null.
x-enumDescriptions.boing_getBlobSampleServeChallenge: Phase 24 get-by-key lookup for one sample-serve challenge.
x-enumDescriptions.boing_getContractCode: Read-only. Returns the deployed bytecode of a contract account and its code hash.
x-enumDescriptions.boing_getContractStorage: Read a single 32-byte Boing VM storage word for a contract (same semantics as `SLOAD`: missing slot → zero word). Useful for indexers and wallets that know the storage key layout (e.g. reference NF...
x-enumDescriptions.boing_getDexToken: Single token row from the DEX-derived discovery universe. Factory: params.factory or BOING_CANONICAL_NATIVE_DEX_FACTORY. Optional light / enrich; includeDiagnostics for scan counters; decimals: BOING_DEX_TOKEN_DECIMALS_JSON, else 0 for reference fungible template code (v2 etc.), else null.
x-enumDescriptions.boing_getLogs: Query execution logs across a bounded range of committed blocks. Intended for indexers and wallets; nodes enforce limits to keep scans cheap.
x-enumDescriptions.boing_getMediaBlobParams: L1 media blob caps, activation height, and gas knobs (PutBlob; not interface SSTORE).
x-enumDescriptions.boing_getNameInfo: Name validity, availability, yearly rent (burned), record in any status and registry params.
x-enumDescriptions.boing_getNetworkFeePolicy: Read the effective native fee policy (same JSON shape as `network_fee_config.json`).
x-enumDescriptions.boing_getNetworkInfo: Single-call snapshot for dApps: chain metadata (from env when configured), tip state, timing, client build, consensus summary, `chain_native` aggregates, and `rpc.not_available` (see [dApp network ...
x-enumDescriptions.boing_getQaRegistry: Return the effective protocol QA rule registry the node uses for deployment checks (read-only, no authentication). Same JSON shape as on-disk `qa_registry.json` and as the first argument to `boing_...
x-enumDescriptions.boing_getRpcMethodCatalog: Returns the embedded method catalog (JSON Schema–style `params` / `result` hints per method) shipped with the node binary. Intended for codegen, docs generators, and IDE tooling.
x-enumDescriptions.boing_getRpcOpenApi: Returns a minimal OpenAPI 3.1 JSON document describing `POST /` (JSON-RPC envelope), `GET /ws` (subscribe protocol), and plain-text probes `GET /live` / `GET /ready`. Complements the human-readable...
x-enumDescriptions.boing_getSyncState: Structured view of the node’s committed chain tip for clients that want explicit head vs finalized fields. Today both heights are identical.
x-enumDescriptions.boing_getTokenMetadata: Name, symbol, decimals and total supply for ANY token contract, not only tokens in a DEX pool. Params: ["0x<32-byte id>"] or [{ "id": "0x…" }]. name/symbol exist only in the deploy transaction (ContractDeployWithPurposeAndMetadata); null when the token was deployed without them (never an abbreviation). decimals: BOING_DEX_TOKEN_DECIMALS_JSON, else 0 for reference fungible template code, 18 for wrapped BOING, else null. totalSupply is a decimal string: wrapped BOING from storage, reference tokens from the one-time mint_first call (totalSupplySource), else null. Returns null when the id has no contract code and no recorded deploy. Non-consensus; works without a DEX factory.
x-enumDescriptions.boing_getTransactionReceipt: Lookup execution outcome for an included transaction (same id as `Transaction::id()` / mempool `tx_hash`).
x-enumDescriptions.boing_getValidators: List the current validator set and (in open mode) every registered validator.
x-enumDescriptions.boing_governanceAdvanceCooling: Move a proposal from Proposal → Cooling (starts the cooling timer). Requires `X-Boing-Operator`. Params: `[proposal_id]`. Fails with quorum-not-met when `strict_quorum` is enabled and approve weigh...
x-enumDescriptions.boing_governanceAdvanceExecution: Move a proposal from Cooling → Execution after the cooling period ends. Requires `X-Boing-Operator`. Params: `[proposal_id]`.
x-enumDescriptions.boing_governanceExecute: Execute a proposal in the Execution window and apply the allowlisted key via the same setters as `boing_operatorApply*`. Requires `X-Boing-Operator`. Params: `[proposal_id]`. Result: `{ ok: true, i...
x-enumDescriptions.boing_governanceGetProposal: Read one open proposal (or `null`). No auth. Params: `[proposal_id]`.
x-enumDescriptions.boing_governanceListProposals: List open proposals. No auth. Params: `[]`. Result: `{ proposals: [...] }`.
x-enumDescriptions.boing_governancePropose: Create a phased governance proposal for an allowlisted policy key. Requires `X-Boing-Operator`. Instant `boing_operatorApply*` remains available; this path adds Proposal → Cooling → Execution befor...
x-enumDescriptions.boing_governanceVote: Cast (or replace) a stake-weighted ballot on an open proposal. Requires `X-Boing-Operator`.
x-enumDescriptions.boing_health: Lightweight liveness and build identity for probes, dashboards, and load balancers. Single round-trip; includes committed `head_height` and the same optional `chain_id` / `chain_name` semantics as ...
x-enumDescriptions.boing_listBlobSampleServeChallenges: Read-only list of SMT sample-serve challenges (Phase 10+). Phase 24 adds filters and optional list-all.
x-enumDescriptions.boing_listDexPools: Cursor-paginated native DEX pools (directory + live reserves). Each row includes tokenADecimals/tokenBDecimals (BOING_DEX_TOKEN_DECIMALS_JSON, else 0 for reference fungible template code, else null). Factory: params.factory or env. Receipt-backed createdAtHeight unless light=true; BOING_DEX_DISCOVERY_MAX_RECEIPT_SCANS; includeDiagnostics.
x-enumDescriptions.boing_listDexTokens: DEX-derived token set with optional minReserveProduct / minLiquidityWei. Enriches from receipts + recent metadata deploys unless light=true. Factory: params.factory or env. includeDiagnostics; BOING_DEX_TOKEN_DECIMALS_JSON.
x-enumDescriptions.boing_listSlashRecords: Read-only view of the consensus `SlashAppealRegistry` joined with the node-local mirror (equivocation / liveness / FailedServe slashes + appeals).
x-enumDescriptions.boing_listTokens: Cursor-paginated token directory independent of the DEX: every contract that declared a name/symbol at deploy or runs a known token implementation (reference fungible v1/v2/secured, wrapped BOING). Params: [{ limit?: 1-500 (default 100), cursor?: last id from nextCursor }]. Rows have the boing_getTokenMetadata shape, ordered by id. Result: { tokens, nextCursor, total, indexedThroughHeight }. Non-consensus.
x-enumDescriptions.boing_namesOwnedBy: Names owned by an address (active or in grace).
x-enumDescriptions.boing_operatorApplyFeePolicy: Replace the node’s native fee policy (persists `network_fee_config.json`). Requires `X-Boing-Operator` matching `BOING_OPERATOR_RPC_TOKEN`; rejected with `-32057` if the token is unset.
x-enumDescriptions.boing_operatorApplyQaPolicy: Replace the node’s in-memory QA registry and pool governance config (same effect as loading `qa_registry.json` / `qa_pool_config.json` at startup, plus persistence to the node data directory). Inte...
x-enumDescriptions.boing_qaCheck: Run QA checks on contract bytecode/metadata.
x-enumDescriptions.boing_qaPoolConfig: Read effective QA pool governance parameters and current queue depth (no params).
x-enumDescriptions.boing_qaPoolList: List pending items in the community QA pool (same `tx_hash` keys as `-32051`).
x-enumDescriptions.boing_qaPoolVote: Cast a vote on a pending pool item.
x-enumDescriptions.boing_registerDappMetrics: Register a dApp for incentive tracking.
x-enumDescriptions.boing_resolveName: Resolve an active name (alice or alice.boing) to {target, owner, expires_at, status}; null if unregistered, in grace or expired.
x-enumDescriptions.boing_resolveSlashAppeal: Approve or reject a pending appeal. Approval restores burned stake from the fee burn sink.
x-enumDescriptions.boing_reverifySlashAppealBallots: Phase 22/23 read-only audit of consensus slash-appeal resolve ballots (Ed25519 dual-verify V2 then V1), pin-set match, and registry commitment. Never mutates book state.
x-enumDescriptions.boing_reverseName: Verified primary name of an address (set by that address and resolving back to it), or null.
x-enumDescriptions.boing_rpcSupportedMethods: Result: JSON array of strings — sorted list of `boing_*` method names implemented by this process (including `boing_clientVersion` and `boing_rpcSupportedMethods`). Intended for discovery and debug...
x-enumDescriptions.boing_simulateContractCall: Dry-run a `contract_call` without building or signing a full `SignedTransaction`. Execution uses the same VM path as `boing_simulateTransaction` on a state snapshot (no commit to committed chain).
x-enumDescriptions.boing_simulateTransaction: Simulate a transaction without applying it.
x-enumDescriptions.boing_submitIntent: Submit a signed intent for solver fulfillment.
x-enumDescriptions.boing_submitSlashAppeal: Submit an appeal against a recorded slash (within the appeal window).
x-enumDescriptions.boing_submitTransaction: Submit a signed transaction to the mempool.

params.description: JSON-RPC params (almost always a JSON array; see each method).

boing_http.description: Optional HTTP-level envelope (e.g. **429** rate limit correlation).

boing_getDexToken_Result.description: Token object or JSON null when unknown

receipt_retention_blocks.description: Receipt window in blocks; null = unbounded.

storage_tree_v2_activation_height.description: null = not configured (legacy 64-bit contract-storage routing, roots unchanged). Integer H = 256-bit routing at height >= H.

boing_getTokenMetadata_Result.description: Token metadata object or JSON null when the id is not a contract

client_hints.description: Advisory wallet/SDK version hints (never enforced). Overridable with BOING_MIN_WALLET_VERSION, BOING_RECOMMENDED_WALLET_VERSION, BOING_RECOMMENDED_SDK_VERSION.

min_wallet_version.description: Oldest Boing Express release that signs correctly and shows height-aware 18-decimal BOING amounts for this network (semver; default 0.1.18).

p2p.description: Read-only P2P snapshot: distinct connected peers and configured / connected bootnode addresses (bootnodes are redialed with backoff).

receipt_retention_blocks.description: Receipt window in blocks; null = unbounded.

rpc_metrics.description: Monotonic counters since process start (best-effort diagnostics).

storage_tree_v2_activation_height.description: null = not configured (legacy 64-bit contract-storage routing, roots unchanged). Integer H = 256-bit routing at height >= H.

prefixItems.description: optional sender AccountId hex; omit or null for zero sender
optional at_block: "latest", null, or current tip height (integer)
